question: The famous musician Vishnu Govind Jog is primarily associated with which of the following musical instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Violin**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Vishnu Govind Jog** was a renowned Indian violinist.
 
• He was one of the prominent figures in the field of Indian classical music, specifically known for his contributions to the **Hindustani classical tradition**.
 
• Jog was awarded several prestigious awards including the Padma Bhus
